current_candidate_count.llm_no_online_generators: 1 or2 genuine Anchor proposals; no padding

failure_fallback: historical action id matched38 in no-generators means original Anchor only; no removed generator may execute
active_stage: unchanged remaining<=.30; two points; CEC original structural lock
candidate_generation: no-agent retains unmodified original six-generator bank; no-generators removes all six and extra native proposal, retaining original Anchor and optional delayed Anchor temperature variant
fusion: current candidates predicted before API; lambda0/1/2 applied now and next4 rounds; original numerical coefficients and gates retained
release_semantics: original selector on current pool, not a reset to original trajectory
output_semantics: one canonical action string per trajectory; complete final JSON only; per-row validation; duplicate JSON keys/unknown ids/truncation reject request
case_features: original8 plus current conflict, fusion choices, uncertainty, residual spread, online gap, rank correlation and selected rank reliability/sample fraction
offline_split: same7 generated heldout functions excluded from retrieval; heldout feature distances only calibrate coverage
coverage_rule: nearest3 distinct functions at same decision step; third distance <= heldout95th percentile; feature metric fit only on training cases
action_support_rule: matched38 always; other actions require coverage, at least2 positive-function neighbors, mean_gain5>max(0,.25*dispersion5), mean_gain10>=0; heuristic support, not confidence bound
offline_summary: all22 action rows; relative gains retained with7 significant digits; no top/bottom truncation

ablation_definitions.no_agent: No fusion_agent or agentic_controller; no LLM, retrieval, case gate, Agent history, Agent extra proposal or Agent re-ranking; retain original Anchor, native bank, online proxy and Residual.
ablation_definitions.llm_no_online_generators: Remove all six runtime generators, the neural-elite generator module and native extra proposal; only original Anchor and optional Anchor temperature variant; retain online proxy, Residual, LLM, fixed Full case evidence and case support gate.

cec_reason: six original structured-system locks; no intervention/API
statistical_claim: development experiment informed by R09; not blind confirmation; no calibrated success probabilities; function/trajectory counts are not significance tests
limitations: generation temperature variants may remain unselected; not forced to pass protected gates
online selected feedback is selection biased, not causal advantage
third-party model routing and billing identity not independently established
case support thresholds frozen before target suite; no target truth in memory

hardware_runtime.batching: fixed per-request trajectories and ensemble members; no cross-request merging

actual_candidate_count: No-Agent: original 36-point bank, core retains two native candidates plus competing Anchor; no-generators: 1 competing Anchor plus optional 1 Anchor temperature variant. No padding.
objective_rng_protocol: Reference no-Agent execution records all201 objective-boundary states; no-generators skips removed draws by restoring each recorded round boundary. All201 evaluation RNG boundaries asserted equal; both final states equal frozen original.
no_agent_proxy_backend: CUDA same as Full, independently of Agent presence; frozen original CPU comparator separately retained
offline_memory: Frozen Full cases, not re-trained or relabeled for module ablation; disclosed to LLM
local_step_action: Inactive alias only in no-generators arm
objective_cache_identity: shape + exact coordinates + objective RNG before, all functions
ablation_old_labels: llm_no_online from R10 is history-input ablation; retrieval is rule substitution. Neither is a strict module removal.
